topic: Direct Speech to Speech Translation: A Review
topic_definition: Stage 2 canonical eligibility, source-faithful to the original paper's screening criteria. Eligible studies focus on direct Speech-to-Speech Translation (S2ST), relate to state-of-the-art machine-learning work, and cover direct or end-to-end S2ST techniques that avoid intermediate text representations.
summary: Stage 2 canonical criteria restated from criteria_mds/2503.04799.md; publication-time filtering is handled by cutoff_jsons/2503.04799.json.

summary_topics.description: Direct Speech to Speech Translation: A Review

required.criterion: Paper focuses on direct Speech-to-Speech Translation (S2ST).
Paper relates to state-of-the-art work in machine learning regarding S2ST.
Paper covers direct S2ST techniques that avoid intermediate text representations.
Paper studies neural S2ST models or architectures such as Translatotron 2, UnitY, or other neural network structures.

exclusion_criteria.criterion: Cascade S2ST models that concern conversion through intermediate text representations are excluded.
Papers presenting machine translation for text-only or audio-only tasks without mentioning S2ST are excluded.
Papers with scant empirical evaluation are excluded.
Papers relying solely on outdated datasets are excluded.
